mechanism: Metronidazole may inhibit vitamin K-dependent clotting factor synthesis by suppressing gut flora that produce vitamin K, potentially reducing anticoagulant effect if patient is on warfarin or other vitamin K antagonists.
action: Monitor INR closely if metronidazole is used concurrently with warfarin or other vitamin K antagonists; vitamin K supplementation may be warranted in prolonged metronidazole therapy.
